apps.name: TextEdit
workflow: Create a Unicode document
Edit, undo, copy and paste
Save, quit, reopen and compare contents
apps.notes: Darling-built open-source fixture, not a vendor-bundle pass. ASCII saving/reopening, single title bar and flicker correction are user-confirmed. Normal Objective-C startup no longer uses DYLD overrides; the user confirmed reopened text, typing and menus. Unicode editing, undo, clipboard and extended stability remain unverified. Swift ABI compatibility with the legacy x86 overlay is not fixed. Rich-text inspector is implemented with partial user-confirmed formatting. Font/size focus regressions pass and screenshot shows DejaVu Serif size 16 applied. Synthetic popup regressions pass, but real multi-output popup acceptance failed: overflow, slow scrolling, pixelated text and font-change lag remain. Orbit bridge is deployed with backups; the later activation and focused-menu result is recorded below. Follow-up native popup-resize and font-metric fixes pass targeted guest checks; latest real menu acceptance remains pending and pixelation is unresolved. On stage23 the user again reports Ubuntu bold failing and the family picker too long; both remain open. Orbit is now active: its real TextEdit process lookup returns a canonical dbusmenu endpoint with all seven top-level menus, and the user confirms focused top-bar menus appear and open. Action execution, disabled/check state, keyboard shortcuts and fallback/restart acceptance are not yet qualified. Stage24 user confirms Ubuntu bold and compact font picker work. User then reports missing persistent formatting-button state/icons and a temporary ruler/tab-marker change during Bold; those UI defects remain open. Stage26 original runtime checks now pass for persistent toolbar state, distinct normal/selected icons, unchanged ruler geometry and synchronous focus observers. New desktop acceptance remains pending.

workflow: Create a dummy vault
Add and copy a dummy password
Save, lock, reopen and verify the dummy entry
apps.notes: Official unmodified Intel bundle acquired and publisher SHA256 verified. Stage4 stopped at an AppKit image-hint import; stage5 progressed to missing Metal stage-input descriptors. Stage6 passed those loader gates and reached native Wayland initialization, then exited 134 on the screen color-space API. No visible UI, dummy-vault workflow or GPU qualification is established. Stage7 adds the screen color-space bridge: the unchanged bundle clears that selector and stops at the next missing NSColorSpace.ICCProfileData method. This is still an initialization failure. Stage9 cleared the compositor-backed localizedName selector and stopped at missing CGDisplayIsOnline. The screen metadata/API regressions pass independently; the application remains blocked during initialization. Stage 11 clears CGDisplayIsOnline and stops at +[NSColor placeholderTextColor] (exit 134). Stage 12 clears that missing selector but exits139 during startup without an exception reason; cause remains unknown. Targeted semantic-color/opacity contracts pass independently, without qualifying the application UI or vault workflow. Stage 19 real UI-font roles, face traits and name-attribute regressions pass independently; the unchanged app still exits139 without an exception reason, so the startup cause remains unknown. Stage 22 still exits139 without a reason after all11 font/icon/model regressions pass; the cause remains unknown and all154 bundle entries are unchanged.
